Subject: Quick technical check before demo?

Hi Jordan + Mateo,

We signed up for a hosted account in your self-serve flow earlier this week and I’m coordinating an internal demo with our engineering lead. Before we commit to a longer session, they asked for a very short technical triage (15 minutes) to confirm model latency profiles, data handling, and whether we can stay on a public endpoint for PII-free telemetry.

Are you able to do a quick 15-min check next week? Our preferred windows are: Tue (13 Jul) 09:00-11:00 ET or Wed (14 Jul) 14:00-16:00 ET. If those don’t work I can do afternoons PT as well.

Couple of short questions to help prep:
- Do you have any whitepaper or short checklist on network requirements for a private VPC deployment?
- Can you confirm token-level logs are available for audit?

Thanks — I’ll try to book once we confirm a time.

Alyssa Turner
Product Manager, Cartology Inc.
alyssa.turner@cartology.com
+1 415-555-0142

--
Note: we may need procurement details later; this is just a quick tech gate to validate fit.

Hi Alyssa — thanks for signing up and for the clear ask. Happy to run a 15-minute triage to cover latency envelopes, logging, and deployment options. Mateo here is our SDR who will help lock the slot.

I can do:
- Tue 13 Jul, 10:00-10:15 ET
- Wed 14 Jul, 14:30-14:45 ET

If either works you can also pick a time directly here: https://calendly.com/redwood/15min-triage

Short answers to your prep Qs so you have something now:
- VPC/on-prem: we have a one-page network checklist (I’m attaching a short triage checklist) that lists firewall rules and ports.
- Token logs: yes — token-level metadata and request/response hashes are available for audit; raw content logging is configurable per-account.

Attachment: triage-checklist.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

If you confirm a time I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and a 15-minute agenda (latency, logs, deployment path).

Best,
Jordan Blake
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
--
On a separate note: if your engineering lead prefers, we can include a short snippet of model performance numbers for the sample prompt you ran in the self-serve flow — just paste one example and I’ll bring it.
